page.overview:
Who is Queen Mother of the West?

The Queen Mother of the West organised a feast for the gods and ordered her attendants, the Seven Fairies, to pick divine peaches from the Peach Tree Garden. The Seven Fairies returned to the Queen Mother after having spent a day frozen by Sun Wukong, who had eaten many of the peaches. The Queen Mother then reported this to her husband.
